scope: read-only full-feature test-quality audit; no source/test modified
summary: The feature's test surface is comprehensive and well-balanced across the pyramid. Every load-bearing invariant of the multi-entry redirect (redirect/start branches, the one-execution invariant, CAS-loss WARN+untouched-state, broken-cursor isolation, anti-IDOR, cross-funnel/two-funnel independence, EMIT_EVENT self-loop termination, index reshape APPLIED/NO-OP + on_start uniqueness, the full set of trigger-validation 422 business codes incl. the distinct intra- vs cross-funnel on_start cases, onStartTriggerValue sync + duplicate-reset, and the on_start fire-lookup rewire) has a concrete, non-vacuous test in the correct layer. Engine/concurrency/index behaviour lives in @Tag("slow") ITs run under -PrunSlow=true; validation in service+controller IT; the panel in component/page specs with no E2E. Findings are MINOR only: the user-spec AC 'без порожніх ключів' (no empty i18n values) is not actually asserted by any automated test — both the parity script and required-keys.spec.ts check key PRESENCE, not non-empty values (an empty-string value passes); a couple of layer/naming notes; no critical or major gaps.

coverage_matrix.behaviour: i18n uk/en parity for triggersPanel keys, NO EMPTY values (user-spec AC 'без порожніх ключів')
coverage_matrix.test: required-keys.spec.ts asserts all funnels.triggersPanel.* keys PRESENT in both locales (presence only). check-locales.mjs asserts key-set SYMMETRY (parity). Actual locale values verified non-empty (17/17 each, manual check). GAP: no automated test asserts non-EMPTY values — collectKeySet records acc[path]=true for ''; toHaveProperty is satisfied by ''. A future empty value would pass green. See finding T-1.

findings.area: i18n empty-value assertion (user-spec AC 'Підписи ... без порожніх ключів')
findings.issue: The 'no empty keys' acceptance criterion is not actually asserted. check-locales.mjs's collectKeySet records acc[path]=true for ANY leaf value including the empty string, and compareKeySets only compares key SETS (presence symmetry). required-keys.spec.ts uses toHaveProperty(key), which is satisfied by an empty-string value. So a triggersPanel key shipped as "" in either locale would pass both gates green. The current locale files are in fact non-empty (verified 17/17 in uk and en), so this is a missing-guard gap, not a live defect.
findings.fix: Add a non-empty assertion to required-keys.spec.ts: load the raw nested value (not just the flattened key) for each REQUIRED_KEYS entry and assert typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0 in both uk.json and en.json. Alternatively extend collectKeySet/checkLocales to also report keys whose value is '' (empty-value diff) and fail the script on it. Anchor the funnels.triggersPanel.* subset at minimum.

findings.issue: The class javadoc and the tech-spec list FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest under 'Unit tests', but it extends AbstractIntegrationTest (real embedded/Testcontainers Mongo, full Spring context) — it is a service-level integration test, not a pure unit test. This is the correct and intentional choice (it exercises real persistence of the array + the onStartTriggerValue scalar + the conflict pre-check), and the pure-logic decision branch is separately unit-covered in FunnelEventServiceTest. Flagging only as a naming/classification mismatch so the pyramid accounting is honest: the genuinely fast unit layer for this feature is FunnelEventServiceTest + TriggerTest + TriggerDtoTest; the validation suite is IT-weighted.
findings.fix: No behaviour change needed. Optionally adjust the tech-spec/javadoc wording to call FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest a 'service IT' rather than 'unit', so the pyramid description matches reality. Acceptable as-is.

findings.issue: The US Risk 4 regression gate asserts the self-loop ends in status=failed AND that LOG_STEP_BUDGET_EXCEEDED was logged via a redundant double-check (warn(appender) OR appender.list). It proves the budget-trip arm of the gate (no-park loop), which is the right arm for a no-menu EMIT_EVENT self-loop. The OTHER arm named in the AC — the human-press/menu-park gate that bounds a loop WITH a menu between turns — is proven only indirectly (menu_parks_on_reply + sweep_does_not_resume_menu_without_timeout show a menu parks and does not self-resume, but not specifically inside an EMIT_EVENT→trigger redirect cycle). The double-condition assertion is also slightly defensive/redundant.
findings.fix: Optional hardening: add one IT variant where the trigger branch contains a MESSAGE-with-buttons (menu) before re-emitting, redirect once, and assert the execution parks waiting_for_reply (the tick ends, no budget trip) — directly pinning the menu-park arm of the loop bound inside a redirect cycle. Simplify the marker assertion to a single appender.list.anyMatch(...). Not blocking: the budget arm is the load-bearing one and is solidly covered.

findings.issue: EventsControllerIT mocks FunnelEventService (@MockitoBean) and verifies dispatchForSubscriber is invoked with the right args; it does not assert the redirect-vs-start row outcome end-to-end through the controller. This is the correct layering (the outcome is proven in FunnelEventServiceIT against real Mongo, and AVP step 4 'API event creates execution at entryStepId (202)' is a curl/bash QA check, not a JUnit test). Recorded so the audit trail is explicit that no full HTTP→engine→Mongo redirect test exists by design, matching the tech-spec/AVP split.
findings.fix: None required. If extra confidence is wanted before deploy, Task 11 pre-deploy QA should actually run the AVP curl scenario (POST /events drops a subscriber mid-funnel) rather than relying on the layered tests alone.

notes: Redirect cursor-move is proven by SEND-COUNT topology (redirect_ofRunningAndWaiting_movesCursor: entry→End=1 send vs s1→tail=2), not by a status flag — kills the mutant where the CAS .set(currentStepId) is dropped.

CAS-loss asserts BOTH untouched state (currentStepId==s1 AND stepRunStatus==in_progress AND sentCount==0) AND the greppable LOG_REDIRECT_CLAIM_LOST WARN via a per-site engine-logger ListAppender — not a bare boolean. Meets the patterns.md split-per-site idiom.

Broken-cursor asserts the failed row's terminal state (failed/done) + LOG_REDIRECT_BROKEN_CURSOR AND that a sibling execution still completes via sweep — the isolation half is genuinely tested, not just the fail half.
One-execution invariant is asserted by COUNTING funnel_executions rows for the pair (==1) plus id-equality, not by status alone.

Index ITs assert the actual index key, unique flag, and the literal partialFilterExpression document ({status:'active', onStartTriggerValue:{$exists:true}}) AND the absence of the old flat-trio index — plus behavioural duplicate-key collision incl. the null/empty-string edge.
Reconciliation markers are exact-string INFO-level assertions (markerCount==1) that cross-check the opposite marker did NOT fire — a reword breaks them by design (Task 12 grep contract protected).

advanceOnCallback_validClick + callbackQuery_eventCarriesNoPii confirm WARN/event payloads carry ids/codes only (doesNotContain firstName) — the no-PII-in-logs discipline is positively asserted, no PII found in any asserted log line for the new redirect/dispatch WARNs.

No vacuous/litmus-failing tests observed in the feature's new tests; mock-return anti-pattern not present (FunnelEventServiceTest mocks at the factory/engine/repo boundary and asserts which branch fired via interaction counts + greppable markers, which is legitimate decision-logic verification at the unit layer).

pyramid_balance.engine_concurrency_index_in_slow_lane: YES — FunnelExecutionEngineIT, FunnelIndexesIT, FunnelTriggerIndexReconciliationIT, FunnelTestRunSendIT all carry @Tag("slow") and run only under -PrunSlow=true. Every load-bearing redirect/CAS/broken-cursor/self-loop/index-reshape invariant lives in the slow lane; none leaked into the default lane and none is faked in a unit test. No DB mocking in any IT (real embedded/Testcontainers Mongo).
pyramid_balance.validation_in_unit_plus_controller_it: YES — trigger validation lives in FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest (service IT) + FunnelControllerIT (HTTP) + TriggerDtoTest (DTO unit) + pure-logic branch selection in FunnelEventServiceTest (Mockito unit). Validation is NOT pushed into the slow lane.
pyramid_balance.panel_in_component_page_specs_no_e2e: YES — FunnelTriggersPanel.spec.ts (component) + funnel-editor.spec.ts (page, real panel mounted) + required-keys.spec.ts (i18n). No E2E for the panel, matching every prior funnel phase and the tech-spec 'E2E: None'.
pyramid_balance.imbalance_flagged: Minor: the validation layer is IT-weighted because FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest (labelled 'unit' in the spec) is actually a Mongo-backed service IT (finding 2). The truly fast unit coverage for cross-trigger rules is thinner than the label implies, but the rules ARE covered (just at the service-IT layer, which exercises real persistence/sync) — acceptable, not a regression risk.

slow_lane_discipline.detail: Grep of @Tag in the funnel test package confirms all engine/index ITs are @Tag("slow"). No redirect/CAS/broken-cursor/self-loop/index-reshape invariant landed outside the slow lane where it would silently skip in the default ./gradlew test. The dispatcher decision IT (FunnelEventServiceIT) is intentionally NOT slow-tagged (embedded Mongo, no real Telegram/backoff ladder) and runs in the default lane — appropriate, since it asserts cursor/row decisions, not the network send path. Per the decisions log, the slow lane was run green (FunnelExecutionEngineIT 67, FunnelEventServiceIT 13, FunnelEventServiceTest 18, index ITs 5+8, FunnelControllerIT 104, FunnelTriggerServiceIT 25).

coverage_gaps: MINOR (T-1): No automated assertion that i18n triggersPanel values are NON-EMPTY — the user-spec AC 'без порожніх ключів' is enforced only by presence/parity checks; an empty-string value would pass green. Values are currently non-empty (manually verified).

MINOR (T-3): The human-press/menu-park arm of the US Risk 4 loop bound is proven only indirectly (generic menu-park ITs), not specifically inside an EMIT_EVENT→trigger redirect cycle with a menu between turns. The budget-trip arm (the load-bearing one for a no-park self-loop) is solidly covered.

INFORMATIONAL (T-4): No full HTTP→engine→Mongo redirect test through EventsController by design; the redirect outcome is proven at the service-IT layer and the API-at-entry path is an AVP curl/QA step.
No critical or major coverage gaps. All user-spec ACs and tech-spec Testing-Strategy bullets map to a concrete, meaningful test.
